sources.snippet: Mistral 7B v0.1 - GGUF Model creator: Mistral AI Original model: Mistral 7B v0.1 Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for Mistral AI's Mistral 7B v0.1. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp.
